suggested_services_note: Each row is one way this kind of work takes money (one of the master's 28 paths per flow). The owner keeps the services that fit and picks ONE path per service and place. Names and amounts are examples from the profession file, not prices.

suggested_services.name: Design consult
suggested_services.example: A free design consult at the showroom or by video: nothing taken, nothing after.

suggested_services.name: Free estimate
suggested_services.example: A free estimate visit; the install is priced after the estimate and billed after the job.

suggested_services.name: Cedar privacy fence, 120 feet
suggested_services.example: A cedar fence quoted from photos: $5,400, with a $1,800 deposit when the signed estimate is in, and the $3,600 rest on the bill after.

suggested_services.name: Gate repair
suggested_services.example: A $175 gate repair, billed after the work: nothing taken to book.

before_times: what's needed: a new fence, a repair, a gate, or stain
about how many feet, and the height and material wanted
is there an old fence to take out
is it around a pool (a pool fence has its own barrier rules)
does the customer own the property, or have the owner's OK
after_time: the way into the yard and any gate code (on the secure page)
dogs that will be in the yard on work days
known private lines the public locate doesn't mark: sprinklers, a pet fence, outdoor lighting, a gas line to a grill or pool heater, septic
an HOA that must approve the fence, and its approval if they have it
where the property line is: a survey or plat if they have one
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult who owns the property, or someone the owner authorizes on a forwarded link (a renter or a property manager); never a minor

stop: someone hurt by a tool or a falling post
safety_and_stop_words.go_on: a fence knocked down by a storm or a car is booked once the area is safe (no lines down)
safety_and_stop_words.what_rosie_says: Gas smell or a hit gas line: leave the area now, and call 911 and the gas company from away. A downed power line: stay far away and call 911 and the power company. No booking until it's safe.

staff.licenses_or_certificates: the crew lead or the business holds any license the state's form asks; helpers work under the crew lead
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs quotes over their limit
staff.stand_in: any crew lead with the skill may take an install; the estimator who wrote the estimate needn't be there
staff.roles: an estimator (measures and writes the estimate) and install crews (a crew lead and 1 or 2 helpers)

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult who owns the property, or someone the owner authorizes on a forwarded link (a renter or a property manager); never a minor
children_and_age.minors_texts: not served; a minor can't book

visit.check_in: estimate visits: the customer's code at the door; install days: the code if someone's home, else nobody needs to be home when the yard is open (DONE with photos)
visit.done: DONE with photos of the finished fence and gates; a walk-through with the customer when they're home
visit.changes_at_visit: rock or roots found while digging (priced per hole, the customer's yes first); more old fence to remove; a gate added; any change is priced and the customer says yes first

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: if a contractor or home improvement license where the state or local rules require one (some only above a job size), else a business registration on file; nothing is looked up
license.ask: the license or registration number and the state it's from
license.insurance: general liability, and workers' comp for a crew, where the state's form requires it; the certificate on file

never_in_a_text: gate or lockbox codes, money details
